title: Al-Qawa'id al-Arba': The Four Fundamental Principles
description: Explanation of Imam Muhammad ibn Abd al-Wahhab's Al-Qawa'id al-Arba' (The Four Fundamental Rules) - a short, essential matn on the rulings of associating partners with Allah (shirk) that every student of knowledge must master. Covers the near-total abandonment of the people before the coming of Islam, the four questions, and the verses used as evidence. Taught by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan (AMAU Academy) with a supplementary session from Shaykh Muhammad Hisham's Foundational Dawrah (Garden of Ilm).
short_description: The four fundamental principles of Islam by Ibn Abd al-Wahhab

modules.title: The Four Rules Explained
modules.description: A full explanation of the short matn of Al-Qawa'id al-Arba'.

lessons.title: Part 1/2 - Explanation of Al-Qawa'aid al-Arba'ah (The Four Principles)
lessons.content: The matn of Al-Qawa'id al-Arba' introduced: the four rules/principles with which Ibn Abd al-Wahhab proves and explains the reality of tawheed and the rulings of shirk, beginning with the well-known statement that the mushrikeen of every era agree Allah alone is the Creator and Provider, yet worship others besides Him. source: AMAU Academy (https://www.youtube.com/@AMAUofficial), a Salafi academy led by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan; English lectures upon the manhaj of the Salaf

lessons.title: Part 2/2 - Explanation of Al-Qawa'aid al-Arba'ah (The Four Principles)
lessons.content: The remainder of the matn: the evidences from the Qur'an and Sunnah cited in the four principles, and how they apply against the various forms of shirk, past and present. source: AMAU Academy (https://www.youtube.com/@AMAUofficial), a Salafi academy led by Ustadh AbdulRahman Hassan; English lectures upon the manhaj of the Salaf

modules.title: Deepening: The Four Rules of Shirk
modules.description: A supplementary session on the four rules in the context of the foundations of dawah.

lessons.title: The Four Rules of Shirk — Shaykh Muhammad Hisham's Foundational Dawrah Day 5
lessons.content: A supplementary deep-dive into the four rules of shirk and how they were used by the Salaf in dawah. Garden of Ilm (Shaykh Muhammad Hisham's Foundational Dawrah).
